stories.title: ChatGPT can now virtually try on clothes for you
stories.simple_summary: ChatGPT now lets you upload a photo of yourself and see how clothes would look on you before you buy them. You can also save items you like to check later.
stories.why_it_matters: If you like to shop online, this could help you avoid ordering clothes that don't look good on you — like having a fitting room on your phone.

stories.title: Google thinks SpaceX’s Starship has to launch 1,600 times before space data centers get off the ground
stories.simple_summary: Google is testing putting computer servers up in space. They think SpaceX would need to make about 1,600 successful rocket trips before this becomes practical.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to tech investors and engineers — nothing you need to act on right now.

stories.title: From EI To HI—Why We Need Human Intelligence In The Age Of AI
stories.simple_summary: Someone is arguing that human judgment and thinking are still important even as AI becomes more powerful.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a general opinion piece — it doesn't describe a specific change or development.

stories.title: OpenAI cuts ties with 3 safety researchers, WSJ reports
stories.simple_summary: Three safety researchers at OpenAI lost their jobs after an internal investigation found they mishandled confidential company information.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to people who work in AI at big companies — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Opus 5.5 loves to tell you ‘this matters’ (and other AI writing tells)
stories.simple_summary: Someone noticed that Opus 5.5 (an AI writing tool) uses certain words much more often than humans do, which gives away that it was written by AI rather than a person.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a technical observation mostly interesting to engineers — nothing affecting ordinary users.

stories.title: Judge dismisses antitrust lawsuits over Google’s AI Overviews
stories.simple_summary: A judge dismissed lawsuits against Google that claimed their new AI search summaries (called AI Overviews) were unfair to websites and news publishers.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to website publishers — if you run a small business, it doesn't directly affect you.

stories.title: Amazon releases its own Jev clone as decision models flood the web
stories.simple_summary: Amazon released its own version of an AI decision-making tool, joining other companies doing the same thing.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to tech professionals and investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Shopify debuts Canvas, a way to build online stores by chatting with AI
stories.simple_summary: Shopify (an online store platform) now lets you build an online shop by chatting with an AI assistant instead of clicking buttons and dragging things around.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're a small business owner wanting to start selling online, this could make it much easier to build your store without hiring help.

stories.title: AI liability fight reaches Senate as Google releases powerful new model
stories.simple_summary: The U.S. Senate is discussing new laws about who is responsible when AI causes problems, and Google released a new powerful AI model.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly about lawmakers and tech companies — nothing specific you need to do yet.

stories.title: A.I. Is Going Rogue. Who Should Be Held Responsible?
stories.simple_summary: Someone is asking who should take responsibility when AI systems make mistakes or cause harm.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a general question being debated — not a specific change or announcement.

stories.title: Brian Chesky interview: AI agents need their own operating system
stories.simple_summary: The founder of Airbnb is discussing how AI agents should work and suggesting they need their own underlying system (like how phones need an operating system).
stories.why_it_matters: This is a tech executive's opinion about the future — mostly relevant to investors and tech professionals.

stories.title: OpenAI’s new agent is a shot at Meta — but can it compete with free?
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI announced a new AI assistant called Dots that it says can do real work, trying to compete with Meta's free AI assistant that has become very popular.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly important to tech investors watching which company wins the AI race — nothing affecting your daily life.
